name: Flwr Bar - 3 Gram THCA Disposable - Oatmeal Cookie - Indica
description:
Hand-crafted Terpene Profile: Fresh-baked nostalgia meets boutique craft in this indulgent blend. Sweet, nutty cookie notes swirl with creamy caramel, warm spice, and just a hint of earthy depth. Each pull wraps you in cozy comfort before lifting you into a creative, social headspace. As the high deepens, a soothing calm spreads through your body, melting into a blissful, sleep-ready state.

Housed in a color-coded purple Flwr Bar 3 Gram THCA Disposable with heavy-duty hardware, premium hemp-derived distillate, and childproof packaging. Powered by cutting-edge Nano THCA for faster absorption, stronger effects, and a boutique-crafted experience built for those who want flavor as unforgettable as their high.

Details

• Oatmeal Cookie (Indica)

• 3 Gram Disposable Vape

• THCA Live Rosin Blend

How to Use

• 5 clicks - ON/OFF

• 2 Clicks - preheat

• Connect device to USB-C cord for charging. Inhale to activate device.

• USB-C cord not included.

Cannabinoids

• Nano THCA

• Delta-8

What is Nano THC?

Nano THC is THC that’s been broken down into microscopic, water-soluble particles for faster absorption and stronger effects. By making THC more bioavailable, nano technology allows your body to feel the benefits quicker and with greater consistency compared to traditional THC.

What is THCA?

THCA Is The Precursor To THC

This enigmatic cannabinoid holds immense potential, offering a multitude of therapeutic benefits. THCA, the precursor to THC, is a cannabinoid found in the hemp plant that converts to Delta-9 when decarboxylated (heated). When combined with other cannabinoids, such as Delta-8, the results will leave you feeling a sense of calm.

What is Delta-8?

Delta 8 is made from pure CBD

 Delta-8, the godfather molecule of the industry, offers a user-friendly experience that is similar to Delta-9. It's perfect for inexperienced consumers and referred to by us as "diet weed" because of its softer effects on the body and mind while providing all the benefits of actual cannabis. Delta-8 is made from pure CBD isolate and is another magical gift from these amazing hemp plants.

What is Live Rosin?

Live Rosin: maximum cannabinoids and taste, naturally

Live Rosin is a premium, solventless cannabis concentrate made from freshly frozen plants, preserving the full spectrum of cannabinoids and terpenes for unmatched flavor, potency, and aroma.

Full Panel COA

Oatmeal Cookie - Indica

THCA Disclaimer

This product is not available for shipment to the following states: Hawaii, Idaho, Minnesota, Oregon, Rhode Island, Utah, and Vermont.
